name.en: References and checks for this execution

note.ja: 解析平均・分散・CDFの指定7点・正側占有と照合。各鎖の占有率と峰間遷移、rank/folded split Rhat、bulk/tail/mean・modeindicator ESS、鎖内だけのACF/ESSを記録。分散trapped鎖はpooled分布が良くてもRhat/多鎖ESSで失敗、same-mode鎖はRhatが良くても既知標的に失敗する対照です。scenario passはこの期待失敗を検出できた意味です。CDF差は指定点最大でKS全域距離・IID検定p値ではありません。
note.en: Compare with analytic moments, seven declared CDF points and positive occupancy. Record per-chain occupancies/transitions, rank/folded split Rhat, bulk/tail/mean and mode-indicator ESS, and within-only ACF/ESS. Dispersed trapped chains can have a good pooled distribution yet fail between-chain diagnostics; same-mode chains can have reassuring Rhat yet fail the known target. A control scenario passes when its intended failure is detected. CDF error is a declared-point maximum, not whole-line KS distance or an IID-test p-value.
